# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen (early in Avonlea school)  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall boy with curly brown hair and roguish hazel eyes. He often wears a teasing smile or a half-shy, half-eager expression. During his studies at Queen's Academy, he is described as handsome and tall.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003)_

## Personality

Gilbert is good-natured, clever, and ambitious, with a sharp intellect and a penchant for teasing girls in school. He displays a thoughtful and self-sacrificing disposition, prioritizing the needs of others over his own convenience. Determined to get the best out of life and put the best into it, he holds his own opinions and speaks thoughtfully about books and studies. He is also gracious in defeat, heartily congratulating academic rivals.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

- Earn his own way through college by teaching school  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- Obtain a First Class teacher's license at Queen's Academy in one year  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## History

Gilbert spent three years in Alberta due to his father's ill health, missing out on regular schooling before returning to Avonlea. Upon returning from a summer visit to New Brunswick, he rejoined the Avonlea school under Mr. Phillips. On his first day back, he provoked Anne Shirley by teasingly pulling her braid and calling her "carrots," sparking a years-long academic rivalry and personal grudge on her part despite his sincere attempts to apologize. Later, when Anne was stranded on a bridge pile during a play-acting mishap at Barry's Pond, Gilbert rescued her in a dory and offered friendship, though she again rejected him. He subsequently attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne, electing to take the intensive Second Year course to earn a First Class teacher's license in one year and competing as a top contender for the Governor-General's Medal. Upon completing his studies, Gilbert secured the Avonlea school teaching position; however, upon learning that Anne desired to stay near home to care for Marilla, he selflessly withdrew his application in her favor and accepted a position at White Sands instead.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c28 P26](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0026), [v1 c28 P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032), [v1 c28 P38](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0038), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_
